entrada.texto:

A thorough comparison of different supply chain 
management systems is presented, highlighting their 
strengths and weaknesses and identifying areas for 
improvement.
The paper explores cutting-edge technologies, such as 
blockchain and SSI, that are being integrated into privacy-
preserving traceability systems, offering novel insights into 
their potential to revolutionize drug traceability.
The results show the efficacy of the proposed system. 
Additionally, the paper identifies emerging trends and future 
research directions in drug traceability, providing a roadmap 
for researchers and practitioners to address the challenges 
and opportunities in this critical area.
We propose a blockchain–SSI integrated vaccine supply 
chain framework that overcomes the privacy, identity 
management, and interoperability limitations of blockchain-
only and identity-agnostic traceability systems.
1.3 Structure of paper
This section describes the flow of the paper; it begins with an 
introduction to the problem of drug counterfeiting and the 
importance of drug traceability systems. It sets the context for 
highlighting the study’s objectives, motivation, and contributions to 
the work. The detailed organization is illustrated in Fig. 3. Section 2 
reviews the SSI & blockchain implications, focusing on privacy-
preserving vaccine supply chain management and their applications 
in healthcare. Section 3 discusses the preliminaries of blockchain 
and SSI and their applications in various industries. Section 4 
provides a detailed methodology of the proposed privacy-preserving 
vaccine supply chain management leveraging blockchain and SSI. 
Section 5 demonstrates the empirical results of the proposed 
framework with comparative analysis. Section 6 and Section 7 
explore the challenges of blockchain-based frameworks for vaccine 
distribution and case studies, respectively. The paper discusses 
future research directions in Section 8, highlighting emerging 
technologies and methodologies that could further enhance drug 
privacy-preserved traceability, followed by a conclusion.

resposta.resumo: O artigo propõe um framework integrado de blockchain e identidade auto-soberana (SSI) para a cadeia de suprimentos de vacinas, visando superar limitações de privacidade, gerenciamento de identidade e interoperabilidade dos sistemas tradicionais. Apresenta comparação de soluções, demonstra eficácia empírica e aponta tendências e direções futuras para rastreabilidade segura em saúde.
